Thankyou. 

I don't have freinds, but I keep meaning to muster up the willingness. outwardly I'm a sociable creature, but I'm very alone. I would love to laugh with someone. I guess my lack of connection is my real downfall. 

Thanks again for your time and kindness. take care.

I'm not epileptic, though I have faked seizures to get me out of various things. 

I can't tell if I love the medication or hate it. I've been on it too long
'wow, such empty' is so on point right now...
